description: The line plot illustrates the Similarity across different Layers for four distinct categories, denoted by a legend where one label is obscured. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 0 to 22 at intervals of 2, though the plotted data extends to an x-value of 23. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four solid lines without markers. The red line, corresponding to the obscured legend label, begins at approximately x=0, y=0.07, rises to a peak at x=6, y=0.26, dips to y=0.16 at x=7, forms a secondary peak at x=12, y=0.18, gradually declines to a low of y=0.08 at x=20, and then sharply increases to end at x=23, y=0.43. The blue line, labeled "en&es", starts at x=0, y=0.06, peaks at x=6, y=0.24, drops to y=0.15 at x=7, reaches a secondary peak at x=12, y=0.17, decreases to a low of y=0.05 at x=20, and spikes to conclude at x=23, y=0.27. The green line, labeled "en&el", begins at x=0, y=0.04, rises to a peak at x=6, y=0.15, dips to y=0.10 at x=7, forms a secondary peak at x=12, y=0.15, declines to a low of y=0.04 at x=19, and sharply rises to end at x=23, y=0.30. Finally, the pink line, labeled "en&bn", starts at x=0, y=0.03, peaks at x=6, y=0.14, dips to y=0.09 at x=7, reaches a secondary peak at x=12, y=0.14, drops to a low of y=0.04 at x=19, and ends with a sharp increase at x=23, y=0.29.
